definitions.explanation: Originally the crest on a battle flag; now mostly figurative — a goal or principle held up as the cause one acts under.

examples.japanese: ⟦{改革|かいかく}→改革：04815_kaikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{旗印|はたじるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{旗印|はたじるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{上|あ}がった→立ち上がる：02128_tachiagaru⟧。
examples.english: They rose up under the banner of freedom.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{政党|せいとう}→政党：04338_seitou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{格差|かくさ}→格差：04839_kakusa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{是正|ぜせい}→是正：05631_zesei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{旗印|はたじるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{掲|かか}げている→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧。
examples.english: The party holds up the correction of inequality as its banner.

notes:
Literally the emblem on a military flag. In modern use almost always figurative: a principle or goal raised as a unifying cause. Frequently the object of ⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧ (to hold up), or used in the pattern X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{旗印|はたじるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旗印|はたじるし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掲|かか}げる→掲げる：12791_kakageru⟧: to raise a banner; to champion a cause
- ...⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{旗印|はたじるし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make ... one's rallying cause

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦スローガン→スローガン：11629_suroogan⟧: slogan — a catchphrase; {旗印|はたじるし} is the cause itself, not just its wording
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧: goal — a target to reach, without the 'rally others under it' nuance
